## Freed v26.10.402-dev

Less work during startup

### Fixes

- Keep Library counts coherent and preserve article targets
- Align feed scroll checks with current card heights
- Constrain mobile settings navigation scrolling
- Avoid counting every checkpoint record during routine Library sync checks
- Record bounded timing for Library checkpoint preparation

### Follow-ups

- Prepare v26.10.401-dev
- Attribute native checkpoint preparation substages
- Skip checkpoint census during cloud preflight
- Full checkpoint preparation retains complete validation and can still take time
- Installed startup and manual responsiveness verification remain separate from synthetic benchmarks
- Priority and social diagnostics remain off; provider and schema activation boundaries are unchanged
- Clearer diagnostics for slow Library sync
- Writer admission delays remain a separate investigation
- This build adds attribution; no reduction in stalls or CPU use is claimed

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
